description: Failure modes tested for PAM service controls in GNOME and KDE settings

failure_modes.behavior: request_pam_toggle refuses with error 'incompatible', no confirmation staged, service stays disabled. set_pam_service_enabled also refuses (defence-in-depth). View greys out the switch (set_sensitive(false)).
On polkit denial, client returns Err, presenter sets error, refresh() re-reads unchanged state. Model shows old (disabled) value — switch reverts on next render.
Enabling a Risky service stages PendingPamToggle in model; service NOT enabled until confirm_pam_toggle called. Cancel clears pending, service stays disabled. Confirm applies the toggle.
HIGH_IMPACT_WARNING constant must contain 'FAR/FRR', 'real-attack PAD', 'experimental', 'not recommended for security-sensitive use'. Dialog renders this verbatim.
Disabling a risky service applies immediately — no confirmation dialog needed. Only enabling risky services is gated.

not_tested_display_only: QML QQC2.Dialog rendering (requires KDE Plasma runtime)
Keyboard navigation (Tab/Enter/Space/Escape) — GTK and Qt defaults, not unit-testable
